name: io.github.xerj-org/xerj
title: XERJ
description: The search engine for AI agents: cited answers from your local code, docs, specs and logs.

environmentVariables.name: XERJ_URL
environmentVariables.description: ES-compatible listener of a running XERJ node (start one with `xerj --insecure --data-dir ~/xerj-data`).

environmentVariables.name: XERJ_AUTH
environmentVariables.description: Authorization header for a node with auth on, e.g. 'ApiKey <key>'. Optional for a loopback node: the key is read from <data-dir>/admin.key.
